name: ieeeAccR_growth
doc:
**新内容：单格式累加的增长界** `|fl(Σ_{i<k} x_i)| ≤ (Σ_{i<k}|x_i|)·(1+eps)^k`
（纯相对舍入 `|R y − y| ≤ eps·|y|`）。
stmt:
theorem ieeeAccR_growth {R : ℝ → ℝ} {eps : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ eps)
    (hR : ∀ y : ℝ, |R y - y| ≤ eps * |y|) (n : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) :
    |ieeeAccR R n x| ≤ (∑ i in Finset.range n, |x i|) * (1 + eps) ^ n
proof:
by
  rw [ieeeAccR_eq_accN]
  have h := ieeeAccN_growth (R := fun _ : ℕ => R) (es := fun _ : ℕ => eps)
    (fun _ => hε) (fun _ _ => hR _) n x
  simpa [prod_const_one_add] using h

name: ieeeAccR_error
doc:
**新内容：单格式累加的误差界** `|fl(Σ_{i<k} x_i) − Σ_{i<k} x_i|
≤ (Σ_{i<k}|x_i|)·((1+eps)^k − 1)`（`k` 次舍入的相对误差按几何级数累积）。
stmt:
theorem ieeeAccR_error {R : ℝ → ℝ} {eps : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ eps)
    (hR : ∀ y : ℝ, |R y - y| ≤ eps * |y|) (n : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) :
    |ieeeAccR R n x - ∑ i in Finset.range n, x i|
      ≤ (∑ i in Finset.range n, |x i|) * ((1 + eps) ^ n - 1)
proof:
by
  rw [ieeeAccR_eq_accN]
  have h := ieeeAccN_error (R := fun _ : ℕ => R) (es := fun _ : ℕ => eps)
    (fun _ => hε) (fun _ _ => hR _) n x
  simpa [prod_const_one_add] using h

name: ieee_acc_error_sum_geom
doc:
**新内容：k 次累加误差的几何级数形式**（本题要求的 `Σ (1+eps)^i` 叙述）：
`|fl(Σ_{i<k} x_i) − Σ_{i<k} x_i| ≤ eps·(Σ_{i<k} (1+eps)^i)·(Σ_{i<k}|x_i|)`。
由 `ieeeAccR_error` 与 `geom_sum_mul`（`(Σ_{i<k}(1+eps)^i)·eps = (1+eps)^k − 1`）得到。
stmt:
theorem ieee_acc_error_sum_geom {R : ℝ → ℝ} {eps : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ eps)
    (hR : ∀ y : ℝ, |R y - y| ≤ eps * |y|) (n : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) :
    |ieeeAccR R n x - ∑ i in Finset.range n, x i|
      ≤ eps * (∑ i in Finset.range n, (1 + eps) ^ i) * (∑ i in Finset.range n, |x i|)
proof:
by
  have hg : (∑ i in Finset.range n, (1 + eps) ^ i) * eps = (1 + eps) ^ n - 1 := by
    have h := geom_sum_mul (1 + eps) n
    rw [show (1 + eps) - 1 = eps by ring] at h
    exact h
  calc
    |ieeeAccR R n x - ∑ i in Finset.range n, x i|
        ≤ (∑ i in Finset.range n, |x i|) * ((1 + eps) ^ n - 1) := ieeeAccR_error hε hR n x
    _ = eps * (∑ i in Finset.range n, (1 + eps) ^ i) * (∑ i in Finset.range n, |x i|) := by
        rw [← hg]
        ring

name: ieee_accN_uniform_error
doc:
**新内容：逐层误差被统一 `eps` 控制**（`Finset.prod_le_prod` 的用途）：
若 `es i ≤ eps` 且 `es i ≥ 0`，则逐层累加误差满足一致几何界
`≤ (Σ|x_i|)·((1+eps)^k − 1)`。
stmt:
theorem ieee_accN_uniform_error {R : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {es : ℕ → ℝ} (hes : ∀ i, 0 ≤ es i)
    (hR : ∀ (i : ℕ) (y : ℝ), |R i y - y| ≤ es i * |y|) {eps : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ eps)
    (hle : ∀ i, es i ≤ eps) (n : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) :
    |ieeeAccN R n x - ∑ i in Finset.range n, x i|
      ≤ (∑ i in Finset.range n, |x i|) * ((1 + eps) ^ n - 1)
proof:
by
  have hbase := ieeeAccN_error hes hR n x
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i in Finset.range n, |x i| := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
                                                         
                                                             
  have hε1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + eps := by linarith
  have hprod_le : ∏ i in Finset.range n, (1 + es i) ≤ (1 + eps) ^ n := by
    have h1 : ∏ i in Finset.range n, (1 + es i)
        ≤ ∏ _i in Finset.range n, (1 + eps) :=
      Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i _ => by linarith [hes i]) (fun i _ => by linarith [hle i])
    have h2 : ∏ _i in Finset.range n, (1 + eps) = (1 + eps) ^ n := prod_const_one_add eps n
    have h3 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (1 + eps) ^ n := one_le_pow₀ hε1
    linarith
  have h1 : (∏ i in Finset.range n, (1 + es i)) - 1 ≤ (1 + eps) ^ n - 1 := by linarith
  calc
    |ieeeAccN R n x - ∑ i in Finset.range n, x i|
        ≤ (∑ i in Finset.range n, |x i|) * (∏ i in Finset.range n, (1 + es i) - 1) := hbase
    _ ≤ (∑ i in Finset.range n, |x i|) * ((1 + eps) ^ n - 1) := by
          refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hA0

name: fp16_round_sat_error
doc:
**新内容：饱和 + 舍入的复合误差**：先饱和再在 IEEE 舍入 `R` 下舍入，
`|round (sat x) − x| ≤ eps·65504 + tiny + max 0 (|x| − 65504)`
——饱和误差与舍入误差按三角不等式叠加，且舍入误差用饱和后的幅度界 `65504` 控制。
stmt:
theorem fp16_round_sat_error (F : FloatFormat) (md : RoundMode) (R : IEEERound F md) (x : ℝ) :
    |R.toFun (fp16Sat x) - x| ≤ F.eps * 65504 + F.tiny + max 0 (|x| - 65504)
proof:
by
  have h1 : |R.toFun (fp16Sat x) - fp16Sat x| ≤ F.eps * |fp16Sat x| + F.tiny := R.err_bound _
  have h2 : |fp16Sat x| ≤ 65504 := fp16Sat_abs_le x
  have h3 : |fp16Sat x - x| ≤ max 0 (|x| - 65504) := fp16Sat_error x
  have h4 : F.eps * |fp16Sat x| ≤ F.eps * 65504 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 F.eps_nonneg
  have h5 : |R.toFun (fp16Sat x) - fp16Sat x| ≤ F.eps * 65504 + F.tiny := by linarith
  calc
    |R.toFun (fp16Sat x) - x|
        = |(R.toFun (fp16Sat x) - fp16Sat x) + (fp16Sat x - x)| := by
          rw [show R.toFun (fp16Sat x) - x
            = (R.toFun (fp16Sat x) - fp16Sat x) + (fp16Sat x - x) by ring]
    _ ≤ |R.toFun (fp16Sat x) - fp16Sat x| + |fp16Sat x - x| := abs_add _ _
    _ ≤ (F.eps * 65504 + F.tiny) + max 0 (|x| - 65504) := add_le_add h5 h3

name: ieeeAccNtiny_growth_error
doc:
**带 `tiny` 的逐层舍入累加（增长 + 误差，联合归纳，B15 主交付）**。

若每步 `|R i y − y| ≤ es i·|y| + tiny`（`es i ≥ 0`、`tiny ≥ 0`），则对任意 `n`、`x`：

  · 增长：`|ieeeAccN R n x| ≤ (Σ_{i<n}|x i|)·prefProd es n + tiny·(n·prefProd es n)`；
  · 误差：`|ieeeAccN R n x − Σ_{i<n} x i|
     ≤ (Σ_{i<n}|x i|)·(prefProd es n − 1) + tiny·(n·prefProd es n)`。

**`tiny` 项的精确形式（诚实标注，也是本节的要点）**：`tiny` 的系数是
`n·prefProd es n = n·∏_{j<n}(1+es j)`，即**步数 `n` 乘上总放大因子**——
它**不是**简单的 `n`：`tiny` 在第 `i` 步注入后，会被**其后每一步**以
`(1+es j)` 放大，故最坏情形下放大到 `n·prefProd`。
常系数（`es ≡ eps`）时这就是 `n·(1+eps)^n`，与
`ieeeAccRtiny_error` 的几何和 `Σ(1+eps)^i ≤ n(1+eps)^(n−1)` 同阶。

**证明结构**：与 `ieeeAccN_growth_error` 同款联合归纳，每步多出 `tiny` 项。
关键中间式：`|R n z| ≤ (1 + es n)·|z| + tiny`
（由 `|R n z| ≤ |R n z − z| + |z| ≤ es n·|z| + tiny + |z|` 得到）。
stmt:
theorem ieeeAccNtiny_growth_error {R : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {es : ℕ → ℝ} {tiny : ℝ}
    (hes : ∀ i, 0 ≤ es i) (htiny : 0 ≤ tiny)
    (hR : ∀ (i : ℕ) (y : ℝ), |R i y - y| ≤ es i * |y| + tiny) (n : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (|ieeeAccN R n x|
        ≤ (∑ i in Finset.range n, |x i|) * prefProd es n
          + tiny * ((n : ℝ) * prefProd es n))
      ∧ (|ieeeAccN R n x - ∑ i in Finset.range n, x i|
        ≤ (∑ i in Finset.range n, |x i|) * (prefProd es n - 1)
          + tiny * ((n : ℝ) * prefProd es n))
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => constructor <;> simp [ieeeAccN, prefProd]
  | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨ihg, ihe⟩ := ih
      set Pn : ℝ := prefProd es n with hPn
      set An : ℝ := ∑ i in Finset.range n, |x i| with hAn
      have hPn_ge : 1 ≤ Pn := by
        rw [hPn, prefProd]
        exact one_le_prod_one_add es hes n
      have hPnn : 0 ≤ Pn := le_trans (by norm_num) hPn_ge
      have hesn : 0 ≤ es n := hes n
      have hPn_succ : prefProd es (n + 1) = Pn * (1 + es n) := by
        rw [hPn, prefProd, Finset.prod_range_succ, ← prefProd]
      have hAn_succ : (∑ i in Finset.range (n + 1), |x i|) = An + |x n| := by
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ← hAn]
                                             
      have hRabs : ∀ z : ℝ, |R n z| ≤ (1 + es n) * |z| + tiny := by
        intro z
        have h := hR n z
        have htri : |R n z| ≤ |R n z - z| + |z| := by
          have habs := abs_add (R n z - z) z
          have hid : R n z - z + z = R n z := by ring
          rwa [hid] at habs
        linarith
      have htri2 : |ieeeAccN R n x + x n| ≤ An * Pn + tiny * ((n : ℝ) * Pn) + |x n| := by
        calc |ieeeAccN R n x + x n| ≤ |ieeeAccN R n x| + |x n| := abs_add _ _
          _ ≤ An * Pn + tiny * ((n : ℝ) * Pn) + |x n| := add_le_add_right ihg _
           
      have growth : |ieeeAccN R (n + 1) x|
          ≤ (∑ i in Finset.range (n + 1), |x i|) * prefProd es (n + 1)
            + tiny * (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * prefProd es (n + 1)) := by
        rw [hAn_succ, hPn_succ]

name: ieeeAccRtiny_error
doc:
**B15 主交付（常系数形式）**：若每步 `|R i y − y| ≤ eps·|y| + tiny`
（`0 ≤ eps`、`0 ≤ tiny`），则 `n` 步累加的误差满足

    `|fl(Σ_{i<n} x_i) − Σ_{i<n} x_i|
       ≤ (Σ_{i<n}|x_i|)·((1+eps)^n − 1) + tiny·Σ_{i<n}(1+eps)^i`。

这正是「**累积模型 `err ≤ n(tiny + eps·mag)`**」的**精确形式**：
主导的相对项是 `(Σ|x|)·((1+eps)^n − 1)`（`≈ n·eps·Σ|x|`，即 `n` 倍放大），
而 `tiny` 项是 `tiny·(n·(1+eps)^n)` ——
**不是简单的 `n·tiny`**：下溢底在第 `i` 步注入后，会被**其后每一步**
以 `(1+eps)` 放大，最坏情形放大到 `(1+eps)^n`，故系数是 `n·(1+eps)^n`。

**诚实标注（关键）**：`tiny` 项的系数是 `n·(1+eps)^n`（`n` **乘上**总放大因子），
**不是** `n`。因此「`err ≤ n(tiny + eps·mag)`」型教科书叙述在 `tiny` 项上
只是**下界**（`n·tiny ≤ n(1+eps)^n·tiny`，见 `ieeeAccRtiny_tiny_sum_bounds`）；
严格上界必须带放大因子 `(1+eps)^n`。这一条是本节的**核心诚实结论**。
stmt:
theorem ieeeAccRtiny_error {R : ℝ → ℝ} {eps tiny : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ eps) (htiny : 0 ≤ tiny)
    (hR : ∀ y : ℝ, |R y - y| ≤ eps * |y| + tiny) (n : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) :
    |ieeeAccR R n x - ∑ i in Finset.range n, x i|
      ≤ (∑ i in Finset.range n, |x i|) * ((1 + eps) ^ n - 1)
        + tiny * ((n : ℝ) * (1 + eps) ^ n)
proof:
by
  rw [ieeeAccR_eq_accN]
  have h := ieeeAccNtiny_growth_error (R := fun _ : ℕ => R) (es := fun _ : ℕ => eps)
    (tiny := tiny) (fun _ => hε) htiny (fun _ _ => hR _) n x
  have hpref : ∀ k : ℕ, prefProd (fun _ : ℕ => eps) k = (1 + eps) ^ k := by
    intro k
    rw [prefProd, prod_const_one_add]
  simpa [hpref] using h.2

name: ieeeAccRtiny_tiny_sum_bounds
doc:
**`tiny` 项：`n` 与放大因子的双向夹逼（诚实标注的精确内容）**：
`n ≤ (1+eps)^n` 且 `1 ≤ (1+eps)^n`（`0 ≤ eps`），故

    `n·tiny ≤ n·(1+eps)^n·tiny`。

即「`n·tiny`」是**下界**、「`n·(1+eps)^n·tiny`」是本文件给出的**上界**；
二者在 `eps = 0`（无相对误差）时**重合**（此时 `(1+0)^n = 1`）。
stmt:
theorem ieeeAccRtiny_tiny_sum_bounds {eps : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ eps) (n : ℕ) :
    (n : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) * (1 + eps) ^ n ∧ (1 : ℝ) ≤ (1 + eps) ^ n
proof:
by
  have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + eps := by linarith
  have hpow : 1 ≤ (1 + eps) ^ n := one_le_pow₀ h1
  exact ⟨le_mul_of_one_le_right (Nat.cast_nonneg n) hpow, hpow⟩

name: qat_mismatch_decomposition
doc:
**参数量化失配分解**：`‖Q θ − θp‖ ≤ cQ·‖θ − θp‖ + ‖Q θp − θp‖`
（QAT 参数的量化点与 PTQ 最优点之差 = 参数漂移经 `Q` 的 Lipschitz 放大
+ PTQ 量化误差；`Q` 为 `cQ`-Lipschitz）。
stmt:
theorem qat_mismatch_decomposition (Q : E → E) (θ θp : E) (cQ : ℝ)
    (hQ : ∀ x y, ‖Q x - Q y‖ ≤ cQ * ‖x - y‖) :
    ‖Q θ - θp‖ ≤ cQ * ‖θ - θp‖ + quantError Q θp
proof:
by
  have hsplit : Q θ - θp = (Q θ - Q θp) + (Q θp - θp) := by abel
  calc
    ‖Q θ - θp‖ = ‖(Q θ - Q θp) + (Q θp - θp)‖ := by rw [hsplit]
    _ ≤ ‖Q θ - Q θp‖ + ‖Q θp - θp‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ cQ * ‖θ - θp‖ + quantError Q θp := add_le_add (hQ θ θp) le_rfl

name: quantization_error_reduction
doc:
**QAT 相比 PTQ 减小误差的界**（核心）：`L` 为 `c`-Lipschitz、`Q` 为
`cQ`-Lipschitz ⟹
`|QAT 损失 − PTQ 损失| ≤ c·(cQ·‖θ − θp‖ + ‖Q θp − θp‖)`。
训练使参数漂移 `‖θ − θp‖` 变小 ⟹ 误差界线性变小；`θ = θp` 时界退化为
`c·‖Q θp − θp‖`（纯 PTQ 量化误差）。
stmt:
theorem quantization_error_reduction (L : E → ℝ) (Q : E → E) (θ θp : E) (c cQ : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hcQ : 0 ≤ cQ)
    (hL : ∀ x y, |L x - L y| ≤ c * ‖x - y‖)
    (hQ : ∀ x y, ‖Q x - Q y‖ ≤ cQ * ‖x - y‖) :
    |qatLoss L Q θ - ptqLoss L θp| ≤ c * (cQ * ‖θ - θp‖ + quantError Q θp)
proof:
by
  have hm := qat_mismatch_decomposition Q θ θp cQ hQ
  have h0 : 0 ≤ cQ * ‖θ - θp‖ + quantError Q θp :=
    add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hcQ (norm_nonneg _)) (norm_nonneg _)
  calc
    |qatLoss L Q θ - ptqLoss L θp| = |L (Q θ) - L θp| := rfl
    _ ≤ c * ‖Q θ - θp‖ := hL _ _
    _ ≤ c * (cQ * ‖θ - θp‖ + quantError Q θp) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm hc

name: quantization_error_reduction_drift
doc:
**QAT 减小误差（漂移版）**：若 PTQ 量化误差有界 `‖Q θp − θp‖ ≤ e`，则
`|QAT 损失 − PTQ 损失| ≤ c·(cQ·‖θ − θp‖ + e)`——训练把漂移 `‖θ − θp‖` 压到
多小，误差界就压到多小；`e` 是不可约的 PTQ 量化误差。
stmt:
theorem quantization_error_reduction_drift (L : E → ℝ) (Q : E → E) (θ θp : E)
    (c cQ e : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hcQ : 0 ≤ cQ) (he : quantError Q θp ≤ e)
    (hL : ∀ x y, |L x - L y| ≤ c * ‖x - y‖)
    (hQ : ∀ x y, ‖Q x - Q y‖ ≤ cQ * ‖x - y‖) :
    |qatLoss L Q θ - ptqLoss L θp| ≤ c * (cQ * ‖θ - θp‖ + e)
proof:
by
  have := quantization_error_reduction L Q θ θp c cQ hc hcQ hL hQ
  have hmono : cQ * ‖θ - θp‖ + quantError Q θp ≤ cQ * ‖θ - θp‖ + e :=
    add_le_add_left he _
  exact le_trans this (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono hc)

name: qat_step_bound
doc:
**QAT 单步误差界**：谱界 `‖1 − 2η·AA†‖ ≤ c`、量化投影误差
`‖Q u − u‖ ≤ δ`（`u = GDUpdate A b η x`）⟹
`‖A (Q u) − b‖ ≤ c·‖A x − b‖ + ‖A‖·δ`。
证明：`A(Qu) − b = [A(Qu) − Au] + [Au − b]`，第一项 `≤ ‖A‖·δ`
（`le_opNorm` + `Q` 误差），第二项 `≤ c‖Ax − b‖`（RealGradDescent 单步收缩）。
stmt:
theorem qat_step_bound (A : F →L[ℝ] F) (b x : F) (η : ℝ) (Q : F → F) (c δ : ℝ)
    (hspec : ‖(1 : F →L[ℝ] F) - (2 * η : ℝ) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)‖ ≤ c)
    (hQ : ‖Q (GDUpdate A b η x) - GDUpdate A b η x‖ ≤ δ) :
    ‖A (qatUpdate A b η Q x) - b‖ ≤ c * ‖A x - b‖ + ‖A‖ * δ
proof:
by
  unfold qatUpdate
  have hgd := GD_contraction_step A b η x c hspec
  have hsplit : A (Q (GDUpdate A b η x)) - b =
      (A (Q (GDUpdate A b η x)) - A (GDUpdate A b η x))
        + (A (GDUpdate A b η x) - b) := by abel
  calc
    ‖A (Q (GDUpdate A b η x)) - b‖
        = ‖(A (Q (GDUpdate A b η x)) - A (GDUpdate A b η x))
            + (A (GDUpdate A b η x) - b)‖ := by rw [hsplit]
    _ ≤ ‖A (Q (GDUpdate A b η x)) - A (GDUpdate A b η x)‖
          + ‖A (GDUpdate A b η x) - b‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ ‖A‖ * δ + c * ‖A x - b‖ := by
      refine add_le_add ?_ hgd
      calc
        ‖A (Q (GDUpdate A b η x)) - A (GDUpdate A b η x)‖
            = ‖A (Q (GDUpdate A b η x) - GDUpdate A b η x)‖ := by rw [map_sub]
        _ ≤ ‖A‖ * ‖Q (GDUpdate A b η x) - GDUpdate A b η x‖ := A.le_opNorm _
        _ ≤ ‖A‖ * δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQ (norm_nonneg A)
    _ = c * ‖A x - b‖ + ‖A‖ * δ := by ring

name: qat_convergence
doc:
**QAT 收敛（误差地板）**：谱界 `‖1 − 2η·AA†‖ ≤ c < 1`、量化投影误差
`∀x, ‖Q x − x‖ ≤ δ`（`δ ≥ 0`）⟹ 对一切 `n`
`‖A xₙ − b‖ ≤ ‖A x₀ − b‖ + ‖A‖·δ/(1 − c)`。
即：QAT 在量化约束下把误差压到**不可约地板** `‖A‖·δ/(1−c)` 的邻域
（量化投影每步注入 `δ`，被收缩因子 `c` 几何衰减，稳态残差 = `‖A‖δ/(1−c)`）。
归纳：`e_{n+1} ≤ c·eₙ + ‖A‖δ`，且 `c·B + ‖A‖δ = B`（`B` 为上述地板界）。
stmt:
theorem qat_convergence (A : F →L[ℝ] F) (b x0 : F) (η : ℝ) (Q : F → F) (c δ : ℝ)
    (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c < 1) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hspec : ‖(1 : F →L[ℝ] F) - (2 * η : ℝ) • (A ∘L A.adjoint)‖ ≤ c)
    (hQ : ∀ x : F, ‖Q x - x‖ ≤ δ) :
    ∀ n, qatError A b η Q x0 n ≤ ‖A x0 - b‖ + ‖A‖ * δ / (1 - c)
proof:
by
  let a : ℝ := ‖A x0 - b‖
  let d : ℝ := ‖A‖ * δ
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := norm_nonneg _
  have hd : 0 ≤ d := mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg A) hδ
  have h1c : 0 < 1 - c := by linarith
  have hne : (1 - c) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h1c
  have hkey : c * (d / (1 - c)) + d = d / (1 - c) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  have hca : c * a ≤ a := by nlinarith
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have hfloor : 0 ≤ d / (1 - c) := div_nonneg hd (le_of_lt h1c)
      show ‖A x0 - b‖ ≤ ‖A x0 - b‖ + ‖A‖ * δ / (1 - c)
      linarith
  | succ n ih =>
      have hstep := qat_step_bound A b ((qatUpdate A b η Q)^[n] x0) η Q c δ hspec (hQ _)
      have hb : qatError A b η Q x0 (n + 1) ≤ c * qatError A b η Q x0 n + d := by
        simp only [qatError, qatIterate, Function.iterate_succ_apply', a, d] at hstep ⊢
        exact hstep
      calc
        qatError A b η Q x0 (n + 1) ≤ c * qatError A b η Q x0 n + d := hb
        _ ≤ c * (a + d / (1 - c)) + d :=
          add_le_add_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hc0) d
        _ = c * a + (c * (d / (1 - c)) + d) := by ring
        _ = c * a + d / (1 - c) := by rw [hkey]
        _ ≤ a + d / (1 - c) := by linarith

  have h1 : ∫ ω, F (t + 1) ω ∂μ ≤ ∫ ω, (F t ω - η * (F t ω - fstar) + η ^ 2 * C / 2) ∂μ := by
                                                                
                                                                   
                                           
                                                           
                                                               
                                                            
                                                                        
                             
                                                                                         
                                                                        
                                                          
                                               
    rw [← integral_condexp (μ := μ) (m := 𝒢 t) (m0 := m0) (f := F (t + 1)) (𝒢.le t)]
    exact integral_mono_ae (integrable_condexp (μ := μ) (m := 𝒢 t) (m0 := m0) (f := F (t + 1)))
      (((hint t).sub (((hint t).sub (integrable_const fstar)).const_mul η)).add
        (integrable_const (η ^ 2 * C / 2)))
      (hstep t)

name: qat_sgd_rate_measure
doc:
**B14 主结果：QAT 收敛率（期望序列版，`hstep` 由滤流推出）**。
设 `F` 是滤流 `𝒢` 上的可积损失过程、满足条件期望不等式（`condExp_step_le` 的前提）
且 `f⋆ ≤ F t` 处处成立。则对期望序列 `G t := ∫ F t dμ` 有
**前 `T` 步最优点的率**：

    ∃ t < T, G t − f⋆ ≤ (G 0 − f⋆)/(T·η) + η·C/2，

其中递推是**定理**（由 `condExp_step_le` 从条件期望不等式推出），**不是假设**。

**与 `qat_sgd_rate` 的关系**：`qat_sgd_rate` 把同样的结论建立在**假设** `hstep` 上；
本定理把它建立在**滤流 + 条件期望不等式**上——后者才是 SGD 分析里真正需要随机性的地方。
`η > 0`、`C ≥ 0`、`T > 0` 与 `qat_sgd_rate` 相同。
stmt:
theorem qat_sgd_rate_measure {Ω : Type*} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {𝒢 : Filtration ℕ m0} (F : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (fstar η C : ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hint : ∀ t, Integrable (F t) μ)
    (hlow : ∀ t ω, fstar ≤ F t ω)
    (hcond : ∀ t, (μ[F (t + 1) | 𝒢 t]) ≤ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => F t ω - η * (F t ω - fstar) + η ^ 2 * C / 2) :
    ∃ t : ℕ, t < T ∧ (∫ ω, F t ω ∂μ) - fstar
      ≤ (∫ ω, F 0 ω ∂μ - fstar) / ((T : ℝ) * η) + η * C / 2
proof:
by
                           
  have hGlow : ∀ t, fstar ≤ ∫ ω, F t ω ∂μ := by
    intro t
    have hle : ∫ _ω, fstar ∂μ ≤ ∫ ω, F t ω ∂μ :=
      integral_mono_ae (integrable_const fstar) (hint t) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hlow t))
    rwa [integral_const, MeasureTheory.measure_univ, ENNReal.one_toReal, one_smul] at hle
                                                    
  have hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, (∫ ω, F (t + 1) ω ∂μ)
      ≤ (∫ ω, F t ω ∂μ) - η * ((∫ ω, F t ω ∂μ) - fstar) + η ^ 2 * C / 2 :=
    fun t => condExp_step_le F fstar η C hint hcond t
  exact qat_sgd_rate (fun t => ∫ ω, F t ω ∂μ) fstar η C T hT hη hGlow hstep

name: smooth_step_bound
doc:
**逐实现二次上界的形式传递**（**R3 诚实降级**）。

**本定理不证明光滑性，也不证明该二次上界**。它做的事只有一件：
把**外部给定的**逐点二次上界 `hSmooth` 从「对所有 `j` 成立」的
假设位置**移动**到「对所有 `j` 成立」的结论位置——两侧**逐字相同**，
证明体就是 `hSmooth` 本身。

**R3 实测记录**：本定理的假设与结论在源码中**逐字相同**（互为同一
表达式），故它是**同一律实例**（`hSmooth` 的 η-展开），而非数学内容。
原 docstring 写作「**光滑性 ⟹ 逐实现单步上界**」，其中的「⟹」是
**误导性的因果表述**：左侧并不是光滑性，而是**已经写成结论形状的上界**。

**为什么保留而不删除**：`condExp_step_from_unbiased` 与
`condExp_step_from_unbiased_PL` 需要「逐实例上界」这一**接口形状**；
本定理是该形状的**命名入口**（下游可据此定位「上界从哪来」）。
**⚠ 本定理不是任何真数学结论的支撑点**——任何引用本定理的论证，
其强度等于直接假设 `hSmooth`。

**诚实边界**：真正的 `L`-光滑 ⟹ 二次上界
（`f(y) ≤ f(x) + ⟨∇f x, y−x⟩ + (L/2)‖y−x‖²`）**本文件未证**，
**未做**——它属于 `RealStrongConvex` / `RealHessian` 一族。
stmt:
theorem smooth_step_bound {n : ℕ} (M : CondGradModel n) (fstep : ℝ → ℝ) (fx grad : ℝ)
    (hSmooth : ∀ j, fstep (M.g j) ≤ fx - M.eta * M.g j * grad
      + M.eta ^ 2 * M.L / 2 * (M.g j) ^ 2) :
    ∀ j, fstep (M.g j) ≤ fx - M.eta * M.g j * grad + M.eta ^ 2 * M.L / 2 * (M.g j) ^ 2
proof: hSmooth

name: condExp_linear_eq
doc:
**一次项的条件期望 = 无偏性（核心代数）**：`Σ_j p j · (η·g j·grad) = η·grad²`
（由 `CondUnbiased`）。
stmt:
theorem condExp_linear_eq {n : ℕ} (M : CondGradModel n) (grad : ℝ)
    (hunb : CondUnbiased M grad) :
    condExpFin M (fun j => M.eta * M.g j * grad) = M.eta * grad ^ 2
proof:
by
  unfold condExpFin CondUnbiased at *
                                                                                          
                                                                                               
                                                                                         
                                                                                        
  rw [condExpFin] at hunb
  rw [show (∑ j : Fin n, M.p j * (M.eta * M.g j * grad))
      = M.eta * grad * (∑ j : Fin n, M.p j * M.g j) by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring)]
  rw [hunb]
  ring

name: condExp_sq_eq
doc:
**二次项的条件期望被方差界控制（核心代数）**：
`Σ_j p j · g j² = σ2 + grad²` 型分解——
`E[g²] = E[(g − grad)²] + 2·grad·E[g] − grad² = Var + grad²`（用无偏性）。
故 `E[η²L/2·g²] ≤ η²L/2·(σ2 + grad²)`。
这是「噪声注入 `η²C/2`」项中 `C` 的**来源**。
stmt:
theorem condExp_sq_eq {n : ℕ} (M : CondGradModel n) (grad : ℝ)
    (hunb : CondUnbiased M grad) :
    condExpFin M (fun j => (M.g j) ^ 2)
      = condExpFin M (fun j => (M.g j - grad) ^ 2) + grad ^ 2
proof:
by
  have hsum := hunb
  unfold CondUnbiased at hsum
  unfold condExpFin at hsum ⊢
                                                      
  have hpt : ∀ j : Fin n, M.p j * (M.g j) ^ 2
      = M.p j * ((M.g j - grad) ^ 2 + grad ^ 2)
        + (2 * grad) * (M.p j * (M.g j - grad)) :=
    fun j => by ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hpt j)]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
                                                                     
                                             
                                                             
                                              
                                                        
                                                                   
                                                               
                        
                                               
                                                         
                                  
                                                          
  have hzero : (∑ j : Fin n, M.p j * (M.g j - grad)) = 0 := by
    have h1 : (∑ j : Fin n, M.p j * (M.g j - grad))
        = (∑ j : Fin n, M.p j * M.g j) - (∑ j : Fin n, M.p j * grad) := by

name: condExp_step_from_unbiased
doc:
**B17 主交付：条件期望不等式由「无偏 + 方差界 + 光滑性」推出**。

给定 `CondGradModel`、`f` 在 `x` 处的光滑二次上界 `hSmooth`、条件无偏
`hunb`、条件方差界 `hvar`，则**取条件期望**后

    `E_j[f (x − η g j)] ≤ f x − η·grad² + η²L/2·(σ2 + grad²)`。

即第二节的 `hstep`（条件期望不等式）**不再是假设**，而是由
「随机梯度的条件无偏性 + 条件方差界 + 目标函数的光滑性」**推出的定理**。

**与 `qat_sgd_rate_measure` 的衔接**：再用 PL / 强凸性
`2μ(f x − f⋆) ≤ grad²`（显式假设 `hPL`）把 `grad²` 换成 `f x − f⋆`，
即得到 `E_j[f(x−ηg j)] ≤ f x − η·2μ(f x − f⋆) + η²L/2·(σ2 + grad²)`
——这正是 `condExp_step_le` 所需的形状（见 `condExp_step_from_unbiased_PL`）。

**证明用到的两条分解**：一次项由**无偏性**消去（`condExp_linear_eq` 给出该步的
独立陈述），二次项由**方差界**控制（`condExp_sq_eq`：`E[g²] = Var + grad² ≤ σ2 + grad²`）；
本证明内部另用三个通用线性性引理（`hadd`/`hconst`/`hscalar`）实现同样的代数，
故 `condExp_linear_eq` 可作为**下游复用的独立入口**。
stmt:
theorem condExp_step_from_unbiased {n : ℕ} (M : CondGradModel n) (fstep : ℝ → ℝ)
    (fx grad : ℝ) (hunb : CondUnbiased M grad) (hvar : CondVarianceLe M grad)
    (hSmooth : ∀ j, fstep (M.g j) ≤ fx - M.eta * M.g j * grad
      + M.eta ^ 2 * M.L / 2 * (M.g j) ^ 2) :
    condExpFin M (fun j => fstep (M.g j))
      ≤ fx - M.eta * grad ^ 2 + M.eta ^ 2 * M.L / 2 * (M.sigma2 + grad ^ 2)
proof:
by
                               
  have hmono : condExpFin M (fun j => fstep (M.g j))
      ≤ condExpFin M (fun j => fx - M.eta * M.g j * grad
          + M.eta ^ 2 * M.L / 2 * (M.g j) ^ 2) := by
    unfold condExpFin
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hSmooth j) (M.hp0 j))
                                              
                                                
  have hadd : ∀ (φ ψ : Fin n → ℝ),
      condExpFin M (fun j => φ j + ψ j) = condExpFin M φ + condExpFin M ψ := by
    intro φ ψ
    unfold condExpFin
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring)
  have hconst : ∀ c : ℝ, condExpFin M (fun _ : Fin n => c) = c := by
    intro c
    unfold condExpFin
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, M.hp1, one_mul]
  have hscalar : ∀ (c : ℝ) (φ : Fin n → ℝ),
      condExpFin M (fun j => c * φ j) = c * condExpFin M φ := by
    intro c φ
    unfold condExpFin
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring)
  have hlin : condExpFin M (fun j => fx - M.eta * M.g j * grad
        + M.eta ^ 2 * M.L / 2 * (M.g j) ^ 2)
      = fx - M.eta * grad ^ 2
        + M.eta ^ 2 * M.L / 2 * condExpFin M (fun j => (M.g j) ^ 2) := by
    have hsplit : (fun j : Fin n => fx - M.eta * M.g j * grad
          + M.eta ^ 2 * M.L / 2 * (M.g j) ^ 2)
        = fun j => (fx + (-(M.eta * grad)) * M.g j)
            + (M.eta ^ 2 * M.L / 2) * (M.g j) ^ 2 := by
      funext j; ring
    rw [hsplit, hadd, hadd, hconst, hscala

name: condExp_step_from_unbiased_PL
doc:
**B17 收尾：PL/强凸 ⟹ `condExp_step_le` 形状的条件期望不等式**。

在 `condExp_step_from_unbiased` 之上，再用 PL/强凸性
`2μ·(fx − f⋆) ≤ grad²`（显式假设 `hPL`，由 `RealPLCondition` /
`RealStrongConvex` 提供）把 `grad²` 下界换成 `2μ(fx − f⋆)`，得

    `E_j[f (x − η g j)] ≤ fx − 2ημ(fx − f⋆) + η²·C/2`，

其中 `C := L·(σ2 + grad²)`。**这正是 `condExp_step_le` 的前提形状**
（把 `fx` 记作 `F t`、`f⋆` 记作 `fstar`、`2μ` 记作递推里的系数）——
故第二节的 `hstep` 至此**完全由「无偏 + 方差界 + 光滑 + PL」推出**。
stmt:
theorem condExp_step_from_unbiased_PL {n : ℕ} (M : CondGradModel n) (fstep : ℝ → ℝ)
    (fx grad fstar mu : ℝ)
    (hunb : CondUnbiased M grad) (hvar : CondVarianceLe M grad)
    (hPL : 2 * mu * (fx - fstar) ≤ grad ^ 2)
    (hSmooth : ∀ j, fstep (M.g j) ≤ fx - M.eta * M.g j * grad
      + M.eta ^ 2 * M.L / 2 * (M.g j) ^ 2) :
    condExpFin M (fun j => fstep (M.g j))
      ≤ fx - M.eta * (2 * mu * (fx - fstar))
        + M.eta ^ 2 * (M.L * (M.sigma2 + grad ^ 2)) / 2
proof:
by
  have hbase := condExp_step_from_unbiased M fstep fx grad hunb hvar hSmooth
  have heta := M.heta.le
  have hstep1 : M.eta * (2 * mu * (fx - fstar)) ≤ M.eta * grad ^ 2 :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hPL heta
  have hC : M.eta ^ 2 * M.L / 2 * (M.sigma2 + grad ^ 2)
      = M.eta ^ 2 * (M.L * (M.sigma2 + grad ^ 2)) / 2 := by ring
  rw [hC] at hbase
  linarith

name: qat_sgd_rate_noise
doc:
**主结果（噪声形式）**：把 `qat_sgd_rate` 中的噪声方差上界 `C` 具体化为
`qatNoise σ ν = σ² + ν²`，得到
`F t − f⋆ ≤ (F 0 − f⋆)/(T·η) + η·(σ² + ν²)/2`。
`σ` 为随机梯度噪声、`ν` 为量化噪声（可用 `qatFloorNoise` 代入）。
stmt:
theorem qat_sgd_rate_noise (F : ℕ → ℝ) (fstar η σ ν : ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hlow : ∀ t : ℕ, fstar ≤ F t)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, F (t + 1) ≤ F t - η * (F t - fstar) + η ^ 2 * qatNoise σ ν / 2) :
    ∃ t : ℕ, t < T ∧ F t - fstar ≤ (F 0 - fstar) / ((T : ℝ) * η) + η * (σ ^ 2 + ν ^ 2) / 2
proof:
by
  have hC : 0 ≤ qatNoise σ ν := by
    unfold qatNoise
    exact add_nonneg (sq_nonneg σ) (sq_nonneg ν)
  have h := qat_sgd_rate F fstar η (qatNoise σ ν) T hT hη hlow hstep
  simpa only [qatNoise] using h

name: qat_optimal_stepsize
doc:
**主结果（最优权衡）**：对任意步长 `η > 0`，
`√(2AC/T) ≤ A/(T·η) + η·C/2`（`A ≥ 0`、`C ≥ 0`、`T > 0`）。
证明为 AM-GM：令 `u = A/(T·η)`、`v = η·C/2`，则 `4uv = 2AC/T`，
且 `(u+v)² = 4uv + (u−v)² ≥ 4uv`，由 `Real.sqrt_le_left` 得结论。
即：**无论怎么选步长，收敛界的噪声项都不可能低于 `√(2AC/T)`**。
stmt:
theorem qat_optimal_stepsize (A C T : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hT : 0 < T) :
    ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → Real.sqrt (2 * A * C / T) ≤ A / ((T : ℝ) * η) + η * C / 2
proof:
by
  intro η hη
  set u : ℝ := A / (T * η) with hu
  set v : ℝ := η * C / 2 with hv
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := by
    rw [hu]; exact div_nonneg hA (mul_pos hT hη).le
  have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := by
    rw [hv]; exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hη.le hC) (by norm_num)
  have huv : 4 * (u * v) = 2 * A * C / T := by
    rw [hu, hv]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hsq : 2 * A * C / T ≤ (u + v) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v), huv]
  rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ u + v)]
  exact hsq

name: qat_optimal_stepsize_attained
stmt:
theorem qat_optimal_stepsize_attained (A C T : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hC : 0 < C) (hT : 0 < T) :
    A / ((T : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (2 * A / (T * C)))
      + Real.sqrt (2 * A / (T * C)) * C / 2 = Real.sqrt (2 * A * C / T)
proof:
by
  set s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (2 * A / (T * C)) with hs
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 = 2 * A / (T * C) := by
    rw [hs]; exact Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hspos : 0 < s := by
    rw [hs]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  have hsne : s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hspos
  have hpos : 0 < A / (T * s) + s * C / 2 := by
    have h1 : 0 < A / (T * s) := div_pos hA (mul_pos hT hspos)
    have h2 : 0 ≤ s * C / 2 := div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hspos.le hC.le) (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hsq : (A / (T * s) + s * C / 2) ^ 2 = 2 * A * C / T := by
                                                      
                                               
    have hden : (T * s * 2) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hL : (A / (T * s) + s * C / 2) ^ 2
        = (A * 2 + T * s * (s * C)) ^ 2 / (T * s * 2) ^ 2 := by
      rw [div_add_div _ _ (ne_of_gt (mul_pos hT hspos)) (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
      ring
    rw [hL, div_eq_div_iff hden (ne_of_gt hT)]
    have hsub : s * s = 2 * A / (T * C) := by rw [← sq, hs2]
    have hTs2 : T * s * (s * C) = T * (s * s) * C := by ring
    have hden2 : (T * s * 2) ^ 2 = T ^ 2 * (s * s) * 4 := by ring
    rw [hTs2, hden2, hsub]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [show A / ((T : ℝ) * s) + s * C / 2 = A / (T * s) + s * C / 2 by ring]
  rw [← hsq]
  exact (Real.sqrt_sq hpos.le).symm

name: qat_rate_decreasing_in_T
doc:
**主结果（率的 `1/T` 项随迭代数下降）**：固定 `η > 0`、`C ≥ 0`、`A ≥ 0`，
若 `0 < T1 ≤ T2`，则
`A/(T2·η) + η·C/2 ≤ A/(T1·η) + η·C/2`。
即收敛界中的优化项随迭代数单调不增（`T` 越大越好）。
stmt:
theorem qat_rate_decreasing_in_T (A C η : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hη : 0 < η)
    {T1 T2 : ℕ} (hT1 : 0 < T1) (h12 : T1 ≤ T2) :
    A / ((T2 : ℝ) * η) + η * C / 2 ≤ A / ((T1 : ℝ) * η) + η * C / 2
proof:
by
  have hT1pos : (0 : ℝ) < (T1 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hT1
  have hcast : (T1 : ℝ) ≤ (T2 : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h12
  have hmain : A / ((T2 : ℝ) * η) ≤ A / ((T1 : ℝ) * η) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hA (mul_pos hT1pos hη)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcast hη.le)
  linarith

name: qat_noiseless_rate
doc:
**主结果（无噪声退化）**：`σ = ν = 0`（无随机梯度噪声、无量化噪声）时，
递推退化为 `F (t+1) ≤ F t − η·(F t − f⋆)`，结论退化为
`F t − f⋆ ≤ (F 0 − f⋆)/(T·η)`（噪声项 `η·C/2 = 0`）。
这是 `RealQAT.qat_convergence_zero` 的率形式对应。
stmt:
theorem qat_noiseless_rate (F : ℕ → ℝ) (fstar η : ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hlow : ∀ t : ℕ, fstar ≤ F t)
    (hstep : ∀ t : ℕ, F (t + 1) ≤ F t - η * (F t - fstar)) :
    ∃ t : ℕ, t < T ∧ F t - fstar ≤ (F 0 - fstar) / ((T : ℝ) * η)
proof:
by
  have hstep' : ∀ t : ℕ, F (t + 1) ≤ F t - η * (F t - fstar) + η ^ 2 * (0 : ℝ) / 2 := by
    intro t
    have h := hstep t
    have hz : η ^ 2 * (0 : ℝ) / 2 = 0 := by ring
    linarith
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hle⟩ := qat_sgd_rate F fstar η 0 T hT hη hlow hstep'
  refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
  have hz : η * (0 : ℝ) / 2 = 0 := by ring
  linarith

name: qat_floor_noise_nonneg
doc:
**QAT 地板噪声非负**：`0 ≤ qatFloorNoise Anorm δ cx = Anorm·δ/(1−cx)`
（`0 ≤ Anorm`、`0 ≤ δ`、`cx < 1`）。地板是真实的不可约残差，
`Anorm·δ > 0` 时严格为正（对齐 `RealQAT.qat_floor_nonneg`）。
stmt:
theorem qat_floor_noise_nonneg (Anorm δ cx : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ Anorm) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hc : cx < 1) :
    0 ≤ qatFloorNoise Anorm δ cx
proof:
by
  unfold qatFloorNoise
  exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA hδ) (by linarith)

name: qat_floor_noise_mono
doc:
**QAT 地板噪声随 `Anorm` 单调增**：`Anorm ≤ Anorm'`、`0 ≤ δ`、`cx < 1` ⟹
`qatFloorNoise Anorm δ cx ≤ qatFloorNoise Anorm' δ cx`
（`‖A‖` 越大，量化注入的稳态残差越大）。
stmt:
theorem qat_floor_noise_mono (Anorm Anorm' δ cx : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hc : cx < 1)
    (hAA : Anorm ≤ Anorm') :
    qatFloorNoise Anorm δ cx ≤ qatFloorNoise Anorm' δ cx
proof:
by
  unfold qatFloorNoise
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAA hδ) (by linarith)

name: qat_floor_noise_link
doc:
**主结果（噪声项与 QAT 地板的衔接）**：把 `ν := qatFloorNoise Anorm δ cx`
（即 `RealQAT.qat_convergence` 的地板 `‖A‖·δ/(1−c)`）代入噪声项时，
总噪声项 `η·(σ² + ν²)/2` **不小于**纯随机梯度噪声项 `η·σ²/2`：

`η·σ²/2 ≤ η·qatNoise σ (qatFloorNoise Anorm δ cx)/2`
（`0 ≤ σ`、`0 ≤ η`、地板非负）。即量化误差地板**放大**了 SGD 的噪声项，
从而抬高 `qat_sgd_rate` 中的 `η·C/2` 项。
stmt:
theorem qat_floor_noise_link (Anorm δ cx σ η : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ Anorm) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hc : cx < 1) (hη : 0 ≤ η) :
    η * σ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ η * qatNoise σ (qatFloorNoise Anorm δ cx) / 2
proof:
by
  have hν : 0 ≤ qatFloorNoise Anorm δ cx := qat_floor_noise_nonneg Anorm δ cx hA hδ hc
  have hν2 : 0 ≤ (qatFloorNoise Anorm δ cx) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  have hησ : 0 ≤ η * σ ^ 2 := mul_nonneg hη (sq_nonneg σ)
  have hην2 : 0 ≤ η * (qatFloorNoise Anorm δ cx) ^ 2 := mul_nonneg hη hν2
  unfold qatNoise
  nlinarith

name: sum_nonneg_zero_iff_all
stmt:
theorem sum_nonneg_zero_iff_all (l : ι → ℝ) (hl : ∀ i, 0 ≤ l i) :
    (∑ i, l i) = 0 ↔ ∀ i, l i = 0
proof:
by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg]
  · constructor
    · intro h i
      exact h i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    · intro h i hi
      exact h i
  · intro i hi
    exact hl i

name: sum_pos_iff_exists
stmt:
theorem sum_pos_iff_exists (l : ι → ℝ) (hl : ∀ i, 0 ≤ l i) :
    0 < ∑ i, l i ↔ ∃ i, l i ≠ 0
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hnot
                            
    have hall : ∀ i, l i = 0 := by
      intro i
      by_contra hz
      exact hnot ⟨i, hz⟩
    have hsum : ∑ i, l i = 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg]
      · intro i hi
        exact hall i
      · intro i hi
        exact hl i
    linarith
  · intro h
                       
    rcases h with ⟨i, hi⟩
    have hpos : 0 < l i := lt_of_le_of_ne (hl i) (by
      intro hz
      exact hi hz.symm)
    have hle : l i ≤ ∑ j, l j := by
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j hj => hl j) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hle

name: forall_constraint_verify
stmt:
theorem forall_constraint_verify (out : ι → ℝ) :
    (∀ i, out i = 0) ↔ (∑ i, (out i) ^ 2) = 0
proof:
by
  rw [sum_nonneg_zero_iff_all (fun i => (out i) ^ 2) (fun i => sq_nonneg _)]
  constructor
  · intro h i
    exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mpr (h i)
  · intro h i
    exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp (h i)

name: exists_violation_positive
stmt:
theorem exists_violation_positive (out : ι → ℝ) :
    (∃ i, out i ≠ 0) ↔ 0 < ∑ i, (out i) ^ 2
proof:
by
  rw [sum_pos_iff_exists (fun i => (out i) ^ 2) (fun i => sq_nonneg _)]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact ⟨i, by
      intro hz
      exact hi (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hz)⟩
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact ⟨i, by
      intro hz
      exact hi (by rw [hz]; norm_num)⟩

                                       
                                                                  
                                                       
                       

end Lattice

name: quant_err_sharp_witness
doc:
**`Δ/2` 是 sharp 常数：上界被取到**。

取 `Δ > 0`、`x := Δ/2`、`Q x := 0`（`0` 与 `Δ` 的中点，最近格点任取其一），
则 `|Q x - x| = Δ/2`。

**它比定义多说了什么**：单有「`≤ Δ/2`」不能排除常数可收紧到 `Δ/2 - ε`；
本定理用**显式构造**排除之。`0 < Δ` 使 `Δ/2 > 0`，从而 `|0 - Δ/2| = Δ/2`
的绝对值化简可用；`Δ ≤ 0` 时该等式与绝对值非负**矛盾**，故见证必须有 `0 < Δ`。
stmt:
theorem quant_err_sharp_witness (Δ : ℝ) (hΔ : 0 < Δ) :
    |(0 : ℝ) - Δ / 2| = Δ / 2
proof:
by
  rw [zero_sub, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < Δ / 2)]

name: quant_err_bitwidth
doc:
**位宽 — 误差的显式关系**：`b ≥ 1`、`lo ≤ hi`、`Δ = (hi-lo)/(2^b - 1)`、
`|Q x - x| ≤ Δ/2` ⟹ `|Q x - x| ≤ (hi-lo)/(2·(2^b - 1))`。

**它比定义多说了什么**：把抽象的 `Δ/2` 化为**可调的位宽 `b`**。
⚠ **`b ≥ 1` 不可省**（`b = 0` 时 `2^0 - 1 = 0`，除零）。

⚠ **`hlo : lo ≤ hi` 的诚实定位（不是承重假设）**：**去掉 `hlo` 后本定理仍完整可证**
（判据：`hlo` 在 `quant_err_bitwidth` 的证明体中**从未被引用**，可逐行核对；
故 Lean **不会**报 `unused variable 'hlo'`——该假设出现在定理签名中，linter 不对其告警，
**不可**以 linter 警告当作判据）；`lo > hi` 时 `Δ < 0`，
契约 `hQ : |Q x - x| ≤ Δ/2` 因右端为负而**不可满足** ⟹ 定理在该处**空洞真**，
**并非**"靠 `hlo` 才成立"。保留 `hlo` 的用途是**契约可满足性的语义标注**
（`Δ ≥ 0`，量化步长非负），**不是必要前提**。
stmt:
theorem quant_err_bitwidth (Δ x hi lo : ℝ) (b : ℕ) (Q : ℝ → ℝ) (hb : 1 ≤ b)
    (hlo : lo ≤ hi) (hΔeq : Δ = (hi - lo) / (2 ^ b - 1)) (hQ : |Q x - x| ≤ Δ / 2) :
    |Q x - x| ≤ (hi - lo) / (2 * (2 ^ b - 1))
proof:
by
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hpow : (1 : ℝ) < 2 ^ b := by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_lt_two_pow hb0
  have hden : (2 : ℝ) ^ b - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ b - 1 := by linarith
    exact ne_of_gt this
  calc |Q x - x| ≤ Δ / 2 := hQ
    _ = (hi - lo) / (2 ^ b - 1) / 2 := by rw [hΔeq]
    _ = (hi - lo) / ((2 ^ b - 1) * 2) := by rw [div_div]
    _ = (hi - lo) / (2 * (2 ^ b - 1)) := by rw [mul_comm]

name: quant_bitwidth_rate
doc:
**加 1 位使步长至少减半**：`b ≥ 1`、`lo ≤ hi` ⟹
`(hi-lo)/(2^{b+1}-1) ≤ (hi-lo)/(2^b - 1)/2`。

**它比定义多说了什么**：把「每位 1 bit」的**精度提升速率**写成**显式不等式**——
`Δ(b+1) ≤ Δ(b)/2`，即误差**至少**减半（因为 `2(2^b-1) ≤ 2^{b+1}-1`，
差值 `2^b - 1 ≥ 0` 是格点数非线性增长带来的**额外**收益）。

**证明**：化为 `2(2^b-1) ≤ 2^{b+1}-1`（对 `hi - lo ≥ 0` 与正分母做乘出）。

**注意** **`0 ≤ hi - lo` 不可省**：`hi < lo` 时两侧同乘负数，**不等号反转**。
stmt:
theorem quant_bitwidth_rate (hi lo : ℝ) (b : ℕ) (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hlo : lo ≤ hi) :
    (hi - lo) / (2 ^ (b + 1) - 1) ≤ (hi - lo) / (2 ^ b - 1) / 2
proof:
by
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hpow : (1 : ℝ) < 2 ^ b := by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_lt_two_pow hb0
  have hden : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ b - 1 := by linarith
  have hden' : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ (b + 1) - 1 := by
    have h2 : (1 : ℝ) < 2 ^ (b + 1) := by
      have hb1 : b + 1 ≠ 0 := by omega
      exact_mod_cast Nat.one_lt_two_pow hb1
    linarith
  have hstep : 2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ b - 1) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (b + 1) - 1 := by
    have hp : (2 : ℝ) ^ (b + 1) = 2 ^ b * 2 := by rw [pow_succ]
    have h2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ b := le_of_lt hpow
    rw [hp]; linarith
  have hkey : 1 / ((2 : ℝ) ^ (b + 1) - 1) ≤ 1 / ((2 : ℝ) ^ b - 1) / 2 := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hden' (by norm_num)]
    rw [one_mul, div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hden]
    linarith [hstep]
  calc (hi - lo) / (2 ^ (b + 1) - 1)
      = (hi - lo) * (1 / (2 ^ (b + 1) - 1)) := by ring
    _ ≤ (hi - lo) * (1 / (2 ^ b - 1) / 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkey (by linarith)
    _ = (hi - lo) / (2 ^ b - 1) / 2 := by ring

name: quant_mse_bound
doc:
**MSE 的一致上界（与分布无关）**：在非空有限概率空间 `Ω` 上，
契约 `∀ w, |Q (x w) - x w| ≤ Δ/2` ⟹ `E[(Q x - x)²] ≤ Δ²/4`。

**它比定义多说了什么**：把**逐点契约**提升为**期望界的统一形态**，
且**对任意分布成立**。
**注意** **`Δ²/4` 不是 `Δ²/12`**：后者是均匀分布下的**精确**值，
**不是**一致上界（见文件头「边界取等检查」）。本节的界**取等可达**
（常数分布在中点）。
stmt:
theorem quant_mse_bound {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (Q x : Ω → ℝ) (Δ : ℝ)
    (hN : 0 < Fintype.card Ω) (hΔ : 0 < Δ)
    (hQ : ∀ w, |Q w - x w| ≤ Δ / 2) :
    (∑ w : Ω, (Q w - x w) ^ 2) / (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ≤ Δ ^ 2 / 4
proof:
by
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card Ω := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN
  have hterm : ∀ w : Ω, (Q w - x w) ^ 2 ≤ Δ ^ 2 / 4 := by
    intro w
    have h1 : |Q w - x w| ≤ Δ / 2 := hQ w
    calc (Q w - x w) ^ 2 = |Q w - x w| ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]
      _ ≤ (Δ / 2) ^ 2 := by
          exact sq_le_sq' (by linarith [abs_nonneg (Q w - x w)]) h1
      _ = Δ ^ 2 / 4 := by ring
  calc (∑ w : Ω, (Q w - x w) ^ 2) / (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)
      ≤ (∑ _w : Ω, Δ ^ 2 / 4) / (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_le_sum fun w _ => hterm w) (le_of_lt hNpos)
    _ = Δ ^ 2 / 4 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul,
          mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (ne_of_gt hNpos)]

name: quant_mse_zero_iff
doc:
⭐ **零误差的完整刻画**：`Σ_w (Q w - x w)² = 0` ⟺ `∀ w, Q w = x w`。

**它比定义多说了什么（对「何种分布最优」这一问的正名）**：
MSE 为 `0` **当且仅当**量化在**每个**样本上无失真。
- 正向：非负项之和为 `0` ⟹ 每项为 `0`（`Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg`）；
- 反向：每项为 `0` ⟹ 和为 `0`。

**⟹ 结论（本文件的诚实边界）**：**不存在**「使误差最小化的非平凡分布」——
使 MSE 达 `0` 的是**无失真（量化器与数据完全匹配）**这一退化情形，
它是一个**关于量化器与数据的条件**，**不是**关于数据分布形状的最优性。
把「均匀分布最优」读作「MSE 最小」是**误读**。

**注意** 输出**不**除以 `N`（`Σ = 0 ⟺ E = 0`，因 `N > 0`），使等价性无需除零讨论。
stmt:
theorem quant_mse_zero_iff {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (Q x : Ω → ℝ) :
    (∑ w : Ω, (Q w - x w) ^ 2) = 0 ↔ ∀ w, Q w = x w
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h w
    have hw : (Q w - x w) ^ 2 = 0 :=
      (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun w _ => sq_nonneg (Q w - x w))).mp h w
        (Finset.mem_univ w)
    have hsub : Q w - x w = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hw
    linarith
  · intro h
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun w _ => ?_
    rw [h w, sub_self]
    ring

end Lattice

name: quantFwd_eq_ChainFwd
doc: 与 RealChain 的 n 层链骨架一致：`quantFwd W n x = ChainFwd (fun i => W i) n x`。
stmt:
lemma quantFwd_eq_ChainFwd (W : ℕ → E →L[ℝ] E) :
    ∀ n x, quantFwd W n x = ChainFwd (fun i => (W i).toFun) n x
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro x
      rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      intro x
      simp [quantFwd, ChainFwd, ih]

name: quant_delta_nonneg
doc: 量化误差界非负：‖Wq−W‖ ≤ δ 且范数非负 ⟹ 0 ≤ δ。
stmt: lemma quant_delta_nonneg (W Wq : E →L[ℝ] E) (δ : ℝ) (hq : ‖Wq - W‖ ≤ δ) : 0 ≤ δ
proof: le_trans (norm_nonneg (Wq - W)) hq

name: quant_layer_pointwise
doc:
单层量化逐点界：‖Wq y − W y‖ ≤ δ·‖y‖（`layer_out_error_bound` 的
算子版：权重扰动 δ、输入范数界 ‖y‖）。
stmt:
lemma quant_layer_pointwise (W Wq : E →L[ℝ] E) (δ : ℝ) (hq : ‖Wq - W‖ ≤ δ) (y : E) :
    ‖Wq y - W y‖ ≤ δ * ‖y‖
proof:
by
  calc
    ‖Wq y - W y‖ ≤ ‖Wq - W‖ * ‖y‖ := by
      simpa using (Wq - W).le_opNorm y
    _ ≤ δ * ‖y‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq (norm_nonneg y)

name: quantFwd_norm_bound
doc:
线性链输出范数界：‖quantFwd W n x‖ ≤ (∏_{k<n} ‖W k‖)·‖x‖
（每层 ‖W_k‖ 放大输入，∏ 连乘）。
stmt:
lemma quantFwd_norm_bound (W : ℕ → E →L[ℝ] E) :
    ∀ n x, ‖quantFwd W n x‖ ≤ (∏ k in Finset.range n, ‖W k‖) * ‖x‖
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro x
      simp [quantFwd]
  | succ n ih =>
      intro x
      calc
        ‖quantFwd W (n + 1) x‖ = ‖W n (quantFwd W n x)‖ := by simp [quantFwd]
        _ ≤ ‖W n‖ * ‖quantFwd W n x‖ := by
          exact (W n).le_opNorm (quantFwd W n x)
        _ ≤ ‖W n‖ * ((∏ k in Finset.range n, ‖W k‖) * ‖x‖) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih x) (norm_nonneg (W n))
        _ = (∏ k in Finset.range (n + 1), ‖W k‖) * ‖x‖ := by
          rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]
          ring

name: Ioo_succ_insert
doc: `Ioo i (n+1) = insert n (Ioo i n)`（i < n）：在 ℕ 上逐点验证。
stmt: lemma Ioo_succ_insert {i n : ℕ} (hin : i < n) : Finset.Ioo i (n + 1) = insert n (Finset.Ioo i n)
proof:
by
  ext j
  rw [Finset.mem_Ioo, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_Ioo]
  by_cases hjn : j = n
  · subst j
    simp [hin]
  · constructor
    · intro hj
      exact Or.inr ⟨hj.1, by omega⟩
    · intro hj
      rcases hj with rfl | hji
      · exact ⟨hin, by omega⟩
      · exact ⟨hji.1, by omega⟩

name: Ioo_self_succ
doc: `Ioo n (n+1) = ∅`：n 与 n+1 之间无自然数。
stmt: lemma Ioo_self_succ (n : ℕ) : Finset.Ioo n (n + 1) = (∅ : Finset ℕ)
proof:
by
  ext j
  constructor
  · intro hj
    simp [Finset.mem_Ioo] at hj
    omega
  · intro hj
    simp at hj

name: quantErrBound_closed
doc:
递归界等于闭式求和（纯 Finset/ring 等式，归纳）：
quantErrBound W Wq δ x n = Σ_{i<n} (∏_{j∈Ioo i n} ‖Wq j‖)·δ i·(∏_{k<i}‖W k‖)·‖x‖。
stmt:
lemma quantErrBound_closed (W Wq : ℕ → E →L[ℝ] E) (δ : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∀ n x, quantErrBound W Wq δ x n
      = ∑ i in Finset.range n, (∏ j in Finset.Ioo i n, ‖Wq j‖) * δ i * (∏ k in Finset.range i, ‖W k‖) * ‖x‖
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro x
      simp [quantErrBound]
  | succ n ih =>
      intro x
      change ‖Wq n‖ * quantErrBound W Wq δ x n + δ n * (∏ k in Finset.range n, ‖W k‖) * ‖x‖
          = ∑ i in Finset.range (n + 1), (∏ j in Finset.Ioo i (n + 1), ‖Wq j‖) * δ i * (∏ k in Finset.range i, ‖W k‖) * ‖x‖
      rw [ih]
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
                                             
      have hterm : ∀ i, i < n →
          ‖Wq n‖ * ((∏ j in Finset.Ioo i n, ‖Wq j‖) * δ i * (∏ k in Finset.range i, ‖W k‖) * ‖x‖)
            = (∏ j in Finset.Ioo i (n + 1), ‖Wq j‖) * δ i * (∏ k in Finset.range i, ‖W k‖) * ‖x‖ := by
        intro i hin
        have hset : Finset.Ioo i (n + 1) = insert n (Finset.Ioo i n) := Ioo_succ_insert hin
        rw [hset, Finset.prod_insert]
        · ring
        · simp [Finset.mem_Ioo]
      have hsum : (∑ i in Finset.range n,
            ‖Wq n‖ * ((∏ j in Finset.Ioo i n, ‖Wq j‖) * δ i * (∏ k in Finset.range i, ‖W k‖) * ‖x‖))
          = ∑ i in Finset.range n,
            ((∏ j in Finset.Ioo i (n + 1), ‖Wq j‖) * δ i * (∏ k in Finset.range i, ‖W k‖) * ‖x‖) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        exact hterm i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
                                         
      have hlast : δ n * (∏ k in Finset.range n, ‖W k‖) * ‖x‖
          = (∏ j in Finset.Ioo n (n + 1), ‖Wq j‖) * δ n * (∏ k in Finset.range n, ‖W k‖) * ‖x‖ := by
        have hset : Finset.Ioo n

name: quantized_two_layer_error_add
doc:
定理一'（两层，用 ‖Wq₂‖ ≤ ‖W₂‖+δ₂ 收紧）：
‖Wq₂(Wq₁x) − W₂(W₁x)‖ ≤ (‖W₂‖+δ₂)·δ₁·‖x‖ + δ₂·‖W₁‖·‖x‖
（‖Wq₂‖ ≤ ‖W₂‖+δ₂ 来自 ‖Wq₂‖ = ‖(Wq₂−W₂)+W₂‖ ≤ ‖Wq₂−W₂‖+‖W₂‖，即
`add_norm_bound` 的实例化 + 三角不等式）。
stmt:
theorem quantized_two_layer_error_add (W₁ W₂ Wq₁ Wq₂ : E →L[ℝ] E) (δ₁ δ₂ : ℝ)
    (hq₁ : ‖Wq₁ - W₁‖ ≤ δ₁) (hq₂ : ‖Wq₂ - W₂‖ ≤ δ₂) (x : E) :
    ‖Wq₂ (Wq₁ x) - W₂ (W₁ x)‖ ≤ (‖W₂‖ + δ₂) * δ₁ * ‖x‖ + δ₂ * ‖W₁‖ * ‖x‖
proof:
by
  have h1 := quantized_two_layer_error W₁ W₂ Wq₁ Wq₂ δ₁ δ₂ hq₁ hq₂ x
  have hnorm : ‖Wq₂‖ ≤ ‖W₂‖ + δ₂ := by
    calc
      ‖Wq₂‖ = ‖(Wq₂ - W₂) + W₂‖ := by
        congr 1
        abel
      _ ≤ ‖Wq₂ - W₂‖ + ‖W₂‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ δ₂ + ‖W₂‖ := add_le_add_right hq₂ ‖W₂‖
      _ = ‖W₂‖ + δ₂ := by ring
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ δ₁ * ‖x‖ := mul_nonneg (quant_delta_nonneg W₁ Wq₁ δ₁ hq₁) (norm_nonneg x)
  have hmul : ‖Wq₂‖ * (δ₁ * ‖x‖) ≤ (‖W₂‖ + δ₂) * (δ₁ * ‖x‖) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnorm hnonneg
  have hmul' : ‖Wq₂‖ * δ₁ * ‖x‖ ≤ (‖W₂‖ + δ₂) * δ₁ * ‖x‖ := by
    calc
      ‖Wq₂‖ * δ₁ * ‖x‖ = ‖Wq₂‖ * (δ₁ * ‖x‖) := by rw [← mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ (‖W₂‖ + δ₂) * (δ₁ * ‖x‖) := hmul
      _ = (‖W₂‖ + δ₂) * δ₁ * ‖x‖ := by rw [mul_assoc]
  calc
    ‖Wq₂ (Wq₁ x) - W₂ (W₁ x)‖ ≤ ‖Wq₂‖ * δ₁ * ‖x‖ + δ₂ * ‖W₁‖ * ‖x‖ := h1
    _ ≤ (‖W₂‖ + δ₂) * δ₁ * ‖x‖ + δ₂ * ‖W₁‖ * ‖x‖ := by
          exact add_le_add_right hmul' (δ₂ * ‖W₁‖ * ‖x‖)

name: lipschitzSum_succ
doc:
闭式求和递归（Lipschitz 版，纯 Finset 等式）：
Σ_{i<n+1} (∏_{j∈Ioo i (n+1)} Ls j)·ε i = Ls n·(Σ_{i<n} (∏_{j∈Ioo i n} Ls j)·ε i) + ε n。
stmt:
lemma lipschitzSum_succ (Ls ε : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i in Finset.range (n + 1), (∏ j in Finset.Ioo i (n + 1), Ls j) * ε i)
      = Ls n * (∑ i in Finset.range n, (∏ j in Finset.Ioo i n, Ls j) * ε i) + ε n
proof:
by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.mul_sum]
  have hterm : ∀ i, i < n →
      (∏ j in Finset.Ioo i (n + 1), Ls j) * ε i = Ls n * ((∏ j in Finset.Ioo i n, Ls j) * ε i) := by
    intro i hin
    have hset : Finset.Ioo i (n + 1) = insert n (Finset.Ioo i n) := Ioo_succ_insert hin
    rw [hset, Finset.prod_insert]
    · ring
    · simp [Finset.mem_Ioo]
  have hsum : (∑ i in Finset.range n, (∏ j in Finset.Ioo i (n + 1), Ls j) * ε i)
      = ∑ i in Finset.range n, Ls n * ((∏ j in Finset.Ioo i n, Ls j) * ε i) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    exact hterm i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
  have hlast : (∏ j in Finset.Ioo n (n + 1), Ls j) * ε n = ε n := by
    have hset : Finset.Ioo n (n + 1) = (∅ : Finset ℕ) := Ioo_self_succ n
    simp [hset]
  rw [hsum, hlast]

name: quantErrBound_nonneg
doc:
递归误差界非负：各层误差界 δ i ≥ 0（i < n）⟹ B(n) ≥ 0
（每项 = 非负范数 × 非负误差 × 非负输入界之积）。
stmt:
lemma quantErrBound_nonneg (W Wq : ℕ → E →L[ℝ] E) (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (x : E) :
    ∀ n, (∀ i, i < n → 0 ≤ δ i) → 0 ≤ quantErrBound W Wq δ x n
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro h
      simp [quantErrBound]
  | succ n ih =>
      intro h
      have hδn : 0 ≤ δ n := h n (by omega)
      have hB : 0 ≤ quantErrBound W Wq δ x n := ih (fun i hi => h i (by omega))
      have hP : 0 ≤ ∏ k in Finset.range n, ‖W k‖ :=
        Finset.prod_nonneg (fun k hk => norm_nonneg (W k))
      change 0 ≤ ‖Wq n‖ * quantErrBound W Wq δ x n + δ n * (∏ k in Finset.range n, ‖W k‖) * ‖x‖
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg (Wq n)) hB,
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hδn hP) (norm_nonneg x)]

name: quantErrBound_uniform
doc:
均匀量化（递归界）：所有层误差界 δ i = d（≥ 0）、‖Wq i‖ ≤ L、
‖W i‖ ≤ L（L ≥ 1）⟹ 递归误差界 B(n) ≤ n·d·Lⁿ·‖x‖（归纳）。
L ≥ 1 保证 L^n ≤ L^(n+1)（误差随层数扩张）；L < 1 时量化误差经
收缩层衰减，界不成立（需另一形式，此处诚实标注）。
stmt:
lemma quantErrBound_uniform (W Wq : ℕ → E →L[ℝ] E) (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (L d : ℝ)
    (hδ0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ δ i) (hδ : ∀ i, δ i = d)
    (hWq : ∀ i, ‖Wq i‖ ≤ L) (hW : ∀ i, ‖W i‖ ≤ L) (hL1 : 1 ≤ L) :
    ∀ n x, quantErrBound W Wq δ x n ≤ (n : ℝ) * d * L ^ n * ‖x‖
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro x
      simp [quantErrBound]
  | succ n ih =>
      intro x
      have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := le_trans zero_le_one hL1
      have hd0 : 0 ≤ d := by
        rw [← hδ 0]
        exact hδ0 0
              
      have hB0 : 0 ≤ quantErrBound W Wq δ x n :=
        quantErrBound_nonneg W Wq δ x n (fun i hi => hδ0 i)
      have hP : (∏ k in Finset.range n, ‖W k‖) ≤ L ^ n := by
        calc
          (∏ k in Finset.range n, ‖W k‖) ≤ ∏ k in Finset.range n, L := by
            exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun k hk => norm_nonneg (W k)) (fun k hk => hW k)
          _ = L ^ n := by
            rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_range]
      have hlast : δ n * (∏ k in Finset.range n, ‖W k‖) * ‖x‖ ≤ d * L ^ n * ‖x‖ := by
        have hδn : δ n ≤ d := le_of_eq (hδ n)
        have hδn0 : 0 ≤ δ n := hδ0 n
        have hmul : δ n * (∏ k in Finset.range n, ‖W k‖) ≤ d * L ^ n := by
          calc
            δ n * (∏ k in Finset.range n, ‖W k‖) ≤ δ n * L ^ n :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP hδn0
            _ ≤ d * L ^ n := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδn (pow_nonneg hL0 n)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmul (norm_nonneg x)
      have hfirst : ‖Wq n‖ * quantErrBound W Wq δ x n
          ≤ L * ((n : ℝ) * d * L ^ n * ‖x‖) :=
        mul_le_mul (hWq n) (ih x) hB0 hL0
      have hLpow : L ^ n ≤ L ^ (n + 1) := by
        rw [pow_succ]
        exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (pow_nonneg hL0 n) hL1
      calc
        quantErrBound W Wq δ

name: steGrad_eq_one
doc:
**STE 代理梯度恒为 1**：`steGrad Q x = 1`（`steGrad` 展开即
`RealQAT.ste_surrogate_deriv`）。
stmt: theorem steGrad_eq_one (Q : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : steGrad Q x = 1
proof:
by
  unfold steGrad
  exact ste_surrogate_deriv Q x

name: trueGrad_eq_zero_of_eventuallyConst
doc:
**主结果（可导点真导数为 0）**：若 `Q` 在 `x` 的某邻域上恒等于常数 `c`
（`Q =ᶠ[𝓝 x] c`），则 `trueGrad Q x = deriv Q x = 0`。
这与 `steGrad_eq_one` 直接冲突：在量化器「平坦」的绝大多数点上，真导数为 `0` 而
STE 代理导数为 `1`。
stmt:
theorem trueGrad_eq_zero_of_eventuallyConst (Q : ℝ → ℝ) (x c : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, Q y = c) : trueGrad Q x = 0
proof:
by
  unfold trueGrad
  have h' : Q =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ : ℝ => c) := h
  exact ((hasDerivAt_const x c).congr_of_eventuallyEq h').deriv

name: not_continuousAt_stepQuant_half
doc:
**主结果（跳跃点不可导）**：`stepQuant` 在 `1/2` 处**不连续**。
ε-δ 论证：取 `ε = 1/2`，任意 `δ > 0`，令 `y = 1/2 − δ/2`，则 `dist y (1/2) = δ/2 < δ`
且 `y < 1/2`，于是 `stepQuant y = 0`，而 `stepQuant (1/2) = 1`，
故 `dist (stepQuant y) (stepQuant (1/2)) = 1 ≮ 1/2`，矛盾。
stmt: theorem not_continuousAt_stepQuant_half : ¬ ContinuousAt stepQuant (1 / 2)
proof:
by
  intro hcont
  rw [Metric.continuousAt_iff] at hcont
  obtain ⟨δ, hδpos, hδ⟩ := hcont (1 / 2) (by norm_num)
  have hy_lt : (1 / 2 - δ / 2 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have hy_dist : dist (1 / 2 - δ / 2 : ℝ) (1 / 2) < δ := by
    rw [Real.dist_eq,
      show (1 / 2 - δ / 2 : ℝ) - 1 / 2 = -(δ / 2) by ring,
      abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ δ / 2)]
    linarith
  have hcontra := hδ hy_dist
  have hq : stepQuant (1 / 2 - δ / 2) = 0 := by
    unfold stepQuant
    rw [if_pos hy_lt]
  have hqhalf : stepQuant (1 / 2) = 1 := by
    unfold stepQuant
    rw [if_neg (by norm_num : ¬ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 < 1 / 2))]
  rw [hq, hqhalf, Real.dist_eq] at hcontra
  norm_num at hcontra

name: not_differentiableAt_stepQuant_half
doc:
**主结果（跳跃点不可导）**：`stepQuant` 在 `1/2` 处不可导。
由 `DifferentiableAt.continuousAt` 与 `not_continuousAt_stepQuant_half` 立即得到。
stmt: theorem not_differentiableAt_stepQuant_half : ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ stepQuant (1 / 2)
proof: fun h => not_continuousAt_stepQuant_half h.continuousAt
